decisions.reason: Its own page and positive if vague result signal public commitment and sunk investment in the renamed line, so escalation makes dropping unlikely.
A public page and a multi-model line indicate substantial visible investment, making management justify and persist.
Only a website mention shows less public commitment, but the multi-model line still represents investment and early results can be attributed to temporary causes.
Mentioned only and a single product suggest less investment and public commitment, raising drop risk, but the recent launch still favors persistence.
Only mentioned and partly overlapping with the general grinder line adds drop risk, yet the product-line investment and early stage favor keeping.
Its own page and multi-model line show clear public commitment and investment, so escalation argues against dropping.
